title: Testimony Now
description: We all have the privilege of religious freedom.  This is a foundational constitutional right in the United States, explicitly protected by the First Amendment, which ensures that all Americans can freely exercise their religion without government interference or coercion. Let us all protect this freedom.

title: 3ABN Today
description: 1. INTRO - 1ST SONG - From the rising of the Sun 2. Personal testimony 3. Ministry - Day by Day 4. The history of God’s people 5. Message of worship 6. The fall of Babylon 7. Worshipping the Beast - Glorious Love 8. God calling His people - Psalm 1 9. NEEDS: Full Time on the Road - Motor Home DIESEL 10. Ministry Timing: Joint Project.
